name: Goshima Yui
source: A 16 year old second year student with a passion for martial arts and fighting games. As Homura's childhood friend, she is the only person Homura hangs out with at school, though they haven't spent much time together outside of that in some time since they began at Ainami. She seems to wish to rekindle the closer bond they once had in middle school.
